signal: White Cup, the CRM and BI platform for distributors, is exhibiting at ISA 2026 and pushing ERP-integrated CRM into the distribution market

email.subject1: a signal play for White Cup
email.body1:
Todd, saw White Cup heading to ISA 2026 and leaning into ERP-integrated CRM for distributors.

As CRO, the bind is usually more distributors in market than reps can cover, with hiring SDRs fast enough off the table. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for White Cup off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Todd, quick follow-up for White Cup.

Most revenue leaders don't actually know how many meetings the team needs to book to hit the number, so coverage gaps show up late and the quarter becomes a scramble. Reps also burn hours on research and CRM instead of selling.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings White Cup needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Todd, last bit of proof for White Cup.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how White Cup's reply rate likely compares to other B2B software teams selling into distribution. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Todd, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Running revenue through a busy event season is plenty on its own.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a distribution-software motion? I'll tailor it to White Cup either way.
